name: 21367-puredecode-7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), sm90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=16, bounded at 1024 requests with a 900 s safety cap, warmup the first 25% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets: every request exactly 256 prompt tokens and 128 output tokens (min = max on both), so the backend forces ignore_eos; temperature 0.0. Prompts are sent as plain text with no chat template, and the engine reports its own token count.
purpose: A quantized 7B chat assistant serving 16 concurrent users with 256-token prompts and 128-token replies on one GPU.
launch:
# Launch config for 21367-puredecode-7b-1gpu. The attention backend is not an engine argument at
# this commit -- it is read only from VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND -- so it is set in tuned.yaml.

model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-GPTQ-Int4
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: true
